transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We have the high school's proposal for a digital music production lab on the agenda today. Before I make any decisions on the equipment, funding, software, and deployment plan, I'd like to hear from each of you. Could the requesting teacher, our instructional technology specialist, and our business-office manager please report any relevant findings you have regarding this proposal?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Dr. Monroe, I want to share a relevant finding from a classroom trial I completed this week. I tested the setup with the enrolled section, and the results showed that all 12 students need simultaneous stations, with one laptop and one USB microphone per student. I recorded these results in my classroom planning log, but I realize the log was not attached to the capital request proposal.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Dr. Monroe, I'd like to share the findings from my completed network and privacy review. The commercial cloud music platform requested in the proposal cannot be used with student accounts. Instead, the district-managed SoundLab EDU platform is approved for use, but it requires managed student accounts plus a security configuration record. I closed the technology review ticket this week, but it has not yet been linked to the purchasing request.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Dr. Monroe, I have a relevant finding from the business office. I received the Arts Innovation Grant award notice this week and filed it in the business-office grant folder. The grant will fund this project, but only up to exactly $6,800, and only if the purchase order is issued by August 20, 2026. This funding note has not yet been added to the proposal.
